segments.title: Your Android has a SCAM shield
segments.say: Your Android has a scam text shield, inside Google Messages.

segments.title: Where to find it
segments.say: In Messages settings, tap Protection and safety, then Enhanced Protection.

segments.title: Gemini spots scam texts
segments.say: Gemini checks texts for scams. Likely scams get a warning.

segments.title: Links checked BEFORE you tap
segments.say: On newer phones like Pixel 10 and Galaxy S26, unfamiliar links get checked before you tap. Not tested by us.
Follow for Phone Trick number 27 tomorrow.
